text: Has the actual system, in its final form, been operated over the full range of expected mission conditions?
helpText: EERE R 540.112-02 as retrieved (template version 11/17/15, published 2022-08-26) defines TRL 1 through TRL 8 only; it contains no TRL 9 definition. This question therefore follows the DoD TRA Guidebook (Feb 2025), Table 2-1, p. 7: “Actual system proven through successful mission operations. Actual application of the technology in its final form and under mission conditions, such as those encountered in operational test and evaluation (OT&E).”
rationale: The EERE source stops at TRL 8; the TRL 9 question is adapted from the DoD TRA Guidebook hardware table, another U.S. Government public-domain source, and the substitution is recorded in docs/sources/SOURCES.md and docs/PROGRESS.md.

text: Has the actual full-scale system been completed and qualified through test and demonstration, fully integrated in the operational environment, with end-user specifications demonstrated?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-8. Actual system/process completed and qualified through test and demonstration - Pre-commercial demonstration: End of system development. Full-scale system is fully integrated into operational environment with fully operational hardware and software systems. All functionality is tested in simulated and operational scenarios with demonstrated achievement of end-user specifications. Technology is ready to move from development to commercialization.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has a near-production-quality system prototype, at or near full scale and with most functions available, been demonstrated in an operational environment?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-7. System/process prototype demonstration in an operational environment - Integrated pilot (system): System prototyping demonstration in operational environment. System is at or near full scale (pilot or engineering scale) of the operational system, with most functions available for demonstration and test. The system, component, or process is integrated with collateral and ancillary systems in a near production quality prototype.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has a system-level (beta) prototype, partially integrated with existing systems, demonstrated engineering feasibility in an environment relevant to the end user?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-6. System/process model or prototype demonstration in a relevant environment - Beta prototype (system): Prototyping implementations are partially integrated with existing systems. Engineering feasibility fully demonstrated in actual or high fidelity system applications in an environment relevant to the end user.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has a component or process prototype been thoroughly tested in a relevant environment, integrated with reasonably realistic supporting elements and conforming to target interfaces?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-5. Component and/or process validation in relevant environment - Beta prototype (component): Thorough prototype testing of the component/process in relevant environment to the end user is performed. Basic technology elements are integrated with reasonably realistic supporting elements based on available technologies. Prototyping implementations conform to the target environment and interfaces.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has a stand-alone component or process prototype been validated in a laboratory environment, demonstrating the concept?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-4. Component and/or process validation in laboratory environment - Alpha prototype (component): Standalone prototyping implementation and testing in laboratory environment demonstrates the concept. Integration and testing of component technology elements are sufficient to validate feasibility.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has an analytical and experimental proof of concept of the critical function or characteristic been achieved (for example, an immature prototype with representative inputs validating predictions)?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-3. Analytical and experimental critical function and/or characteristic proof of concept: Proof of concept validation has been achieved at this level. Experimental research and development is initiated with analytical and laboratory studies. System/integrated process requirements for the overall system application are well known. Demonstration of technical feasibility using immature prototype implementations are exercised with representative interface inputs to include electrical, mechanical, or controlling elements to validate predictions.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Has the technology concept and its intended application been formulated, with analytical or simulation tools developed for that application?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-2. Technology concept and/or application formulated: Applied research activity. Theory and scientific principles are focused on specific application areas to define the concept. Characteristics of the application are described. Analytical tools are developed for simulation or analysis of the application.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.

text: Have the basic scientific principles been observed and reported (for example, in peer-reviewed research)?
helpText: EERE definition: “TRL-1. Basic principles observed and reported: Scientific problem or phenomenon identified. Essential characteristics and behaviors of systems and architectures are identified using mathematical formulations or algorithms. The observation of basic scientific principles or phenomena has been validated through peer-reviewed research. Technology is ready to transition from scientific research to applied research.”
rationale: The source states the level as a definition; the wording is restructured into a plain-language yes/no screening question without changing its meaning.
